cause_quote: The profile appearance feature changed `talk.config` to return `profileAccent ?? snapshot.config.ui?.prefs?.accent ?? snapshot.config.ui?.seamColor`, so the existing Mac Talk loader wrote a personal color into the Gateway fallback.
user_saw: After Talk Mode loaded, clearing a personal accent could leave native Mac chat showing the old color or the theme default instead of the Gateway accent.
summary: The fix removes Talk Mode’s write to the shared accent fallback and leaves ControlChannel responsible for refreshing it from Gateway configuration.
reasoning: I checked the introducing diff and its parent: the Mac Talk loader already copied the returned color into `AppStateStore.shared.seamColorHex`, and #130340 first made that response profile-specific. The later native profile refresh and Gateway accent refresh left the Talk write in place, so clearing the profile could still reveal the overwritten fallback.
